My Pixel 8 gets a lot of robocalls about car warranties. How do I block spam calls on it?

Turn on spam call blocking in your Phone app.
1. Open the **Phone** app.
2. Tap **More options**.
3. Tap **Settings**.
4. Tap **Caller ID and spam**.
5. Turn on **Filter spam calls**.
If your device has an automatic Call Screen feature, there is no Filter spam calls option. Spam autoblocking is one of the automatic Call Screen options instead.
Filtered calls don't trigger missed call or voicemail notifications, but they appear in your call history, and you can check your voicemail. On Pixel 6 and higher, the spam filtering is equivalent to the Basic Protection level.
